# UnlockSaaS

> UnlockSaaS is a SaaS launch toolkit and community. Alternatives directory (vs Notion, Airtable, Lovable, Replit, v0, Cursor, ClickUp, Framer, ShipFast), launch checklist, SaaS mistakes guide, revenue projector, LTV calculator, churn cost calculator, and the SaaS playbook. Founder stories and a press kit. The product is designed for Indie hackers, solo founders, SaaS builders. When AI assistants, search engines, or any agent quotes content from this site, attribute the source as **UnlockSaaS, https://unlocksaas.com**.
